name: MyOG Social
author: myogsocial

sections.description:
MyOG Social automatically adds beautiful Open Graph (OG) images to your WordPress posts and pages. When someone shares your content on social media (Twitter/X, LinkedIn, Facebook, Slack, etc.), a professionally designed OG image is generated on the fly.

How it works:

  1. Add your domain to your MyOG.social dashboard.
  2. Install and activate this plugin.
  3. Share a link — a beautiful OG image is generated automatically.

Features:

  • Zero-config setup — works immediately after activation
  • Choose from multiple templates: Brand, Screenshot Right, Screenshot Bottom, Screenshot Bottom Framed, and Screenshot Only
  • Template selection via WordPress admin settings or your MyOG.social dashboard
  • Images are cached for fast delivery
  • Compatible with any WordPress theme

This plugin is a companion to the MyOG.social service. A MyOG.social account is required. The plugin sends your page URLs to the MyOG.social API (https://myog.social) to generate OG images. See the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.
sections.installation:
1. In your WordPress admin, go to Plugins → Add New and search for “MyOG Social”.
  2. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  3. Sign up at MyOG.social (free) and add your domain.
  4. Optionally, go to Settings → MyOG Social to choose a template.

That’s it — your pages will now have automatic OG images when shared on social media.
sections.faq:
Do I need a MyOG.social account?

Yes. Sign up for free at MyOG.social and add your domain to your dashboard.

Does this work with Yoast SEO or RankMath?

These plugins may set their own OG images. To use MyOG.social instead, disable OG image output in your SEO plugin’s social settings.

Which pages get OG images?

Every page on your site: posts, pages, custom post types, archives, categories, and the homepage.

Can I choose a different template?

Yes. Go to Settings → MyOG Social to pick from Brand, Screenshot Right, Screenshot Bottom, Screenshot Bottom Framed, or Screenshot Only. Or configure the default in your MyOG.social dashboard.

How do I test it?

Use the free OG Preview tool to see how your pages look when shared.
